blocks.text: Breakfast, then a private city tour of La Candelaria, Bogotá’s historic centre (6 hours): the Gold Museum, with nearly 34,000 pieces of pre-Hispanic goldwork and over 25,000 other pre-Columbian artefacts; the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Donation, with works by the renowned Colombian artist Fernando Botero; a panoramic view of Bolívar Square, with the Primatial Cathedral, the Casa de Nariño, the Liévano Palace and the Palace of Justice; and the ascent to Monserrate. Note: the Gold Museum is closed on Mondays, and the Casa de la Moneda and Botero Donation on Tuesdays. Included: private transport, an English-speaking guide, admission to the museums listed above, the ascent to Monserrate, hotel accommodation and a medical assistance card. Lunch and dinner are not included. Overnight in Bogotá.
